==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. While walking across a bridge over a swamp, I was ambushed by Were-Frog bandits. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (Were-Frog Bandits resemble humanoid frogs dressed like medieval bandits.) I summoned a broadsword made of rainbow light using the Reality Warping Stone to defend myself. (The Reality Warping Stone resembles a jagged diamond that is half pink and half yellow.) I sliced open a tear in reality to banish the bandits to another realm.
